system.description:
Materials: Terracotta clay, cast bronze, or brass; liquid oil; exposed fibrous wick.

Physical Description: A shallow, palm-sized reservoir resembling a small, lidless teapot. It features a loop handle at the back for a single-finger grip and an open spout at the front where the oil-saturated wick protrudes. The flame sits entirely unprotected on the open spout.

Duration: 6 hours per flask of oil
